CoMOR Fair Calendars contains dates and places of fairs in history drawn from sources which explicitly state them in calendar form. Below are the collections and sources found in this file, with notes where provided by the researchers.
----------
Collection: COL0023 -  The Huntington Library, Early English Books online (James Wadsworth, The Evropean Mercury describing the highwayes and stages from place to place, through the most remarkable parts of Christendome : with a catalogue of the principall fairs, marts, and markets thorowout the same)
Source Type: manual
Date: 1641
Notes: [none]
See more details at URL: https://fairs-in-history.huma-num.fr/collection/COL0023
